state_file.description: Absolute path to the file recording per-channel cursors and tracked threads. Must be absolute: a plugin's working directory is its own install directory.

channels.description: Channels to listen in. The bot must be a member of each.

id.description: Slack channel id (C… or G…), not the #name.

mode.description: mentions (default): only messages that @mention the bot become items. all: every human message does.

labels.description: Extra labels stamped on every item from this channel, for trigger matching.

direct_messages.description: Turn every direct message to the bot into an item. Defaults to false.

thread_replies.description: Which replies in a mentions-channel thread become items without mentioning the bot again. participants (default): from anyone who already addressed the bot in that thread. mentions: none. all: every human reply.

allowed_users.description: Slack user ids (U…) allowed to start or continue a conversation. Empty means anyone who can reach the bot.

max_per_poll.description: Cap on items emitted per poll across all channels and threads. Defaults to 10.

thread_ttl.description: How long after its last activity a thread is still watched for replies, as a Go duration. Defaults to 24h.

max_threads.description: Cap on threads watched at once; the least recently active are dropped first. Each watched thread costs one Slack API call per poll. Defaults to 50.

transcript_limit.description: How many earlier thread messages a reply item carries as context. Defaults to 50.

ack_reaction.description: Emoji name (no colons) added to a message once Apiary dispatches it, e.g. "eyes". Empty disables it.

post_failures.description: Post a short notice in the thread when a run fails. Defaults to true.

api_url.description: Slack Web API base URL. Defaults to https://slack.com/api; override only for testing.
